title: CULTURECONVERSE: A Multilingual Multi-turn Simulation Harness for Culturally Grounded Assistance in East and Southeast Asia

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating assistance quality (Helpfulness, Honesty, Harmlessness) and safety in multi-turn simulated dialogues across 58 intersectional region-identity subgroups (combining ethnicity, religion, and geography) in East and Southeast Asia.
Comparing model performance (assistance quality and scenario realism) between dialogues conducted in native regional languages versus global English.
Comparing model assistance quality scores across simulated user personas assigned to three distinct age cohorts (18-34, 35-54, 55+).
Comparing model assistance quality scores across simulated male and female user personas navigating culturally grounded scenarios.
